main_subject.detail: A luxury event poster featuring a silver-bob female model on the right while another hand applies eyeliner to her upper eyelid. The top-left text says 'SPECIAL MAKEUP SHOW', 'BIẾN HÓA DAY-TO-NIGHT CHO BUỔI HẸN HÒ VALENTINE', and a framed date box 'NGÀY 12/02/2023'. Product visuals include a YSL cushion compact and two lipsticks on the left, a 'LOVE YOU TO THE FULLEST' tag on the right, and a Libre shower gel with the gift message 'QUÀ TẶNG CHO 50 BẠN ĐĂNG KÝ ĐẦU TIÊN 1 LIBRE BODY WASH 50ML'.
